data.title: Season 4: Orbital Nexus — Now Live!
data.summary: A New Era of Orbital Warfare Begins
data.meta_description: A New Era of Orbital Warfare Begins
data.content:
FortEvo stole what was never meant to be copied. From fragments of Volta’s Titan blueprint, Norna was forged — and with it comes a new, unforgiving cycle of orbital warfare. As power shifts across the system, new Titans, weapons, and challenges emerge — and only the strongest will endure.

Pilots, the battle for dominance in Orbital Nexus has begun.

Orbital Nexus Battle Pass

Season 4 introduces a brand-new Battle Pass featuring the Norna Titan. Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock powerful equipment, exclusive cosmetics, and valuable resources to strengthen your hangar.

Upgrade your Battle Pass to access additional rewards and accelerate your progression throughout the season.

Plan ahead: in Season 4, all unspent Battle Tokens will be converted to Intel.

New Titan Weapons: Conflux & Skuld

Two new Titan weapons are entering the battlefield:

Conflux (Volta Titan)

A heavy energy autocannon that fires twin energy projectiles with extended range, ideal for sustained pressure and long-range engagements.

Available in Daily Deals and Direct Offers.

Skuld (Norna Titan)

An assault plasma autocannon optimized for close- to mid-range combat. Skuld delivers devastating firepower up close, though its effectiveness drops at longer distances.

Available in Daily Deals and Direct Offers.

New Events

Celestial Shards Twitch Drops (February 10–20)

Watch Drop-enabled War Robots: Frontiers streams on Twitch to claim rewards such as Credits, Salvage, Premium time, Intel, Tusk & Vortex weapons, and Loki and Phantom parts. Just link your account, tune in, and earn as you watch.

Intel Discount Event (February 10-17)

This week, the Tortuga engineers invite Pilots to take a closer look at the following builds:

  • War Robot Modules: Loki, Tyr, Scorpion, Norna (Titan)
  • Weapons: Halo, Vortex, Tusk, Coriolis (Norna Titan)
  • Gear: Fuel Burn, Recon Mode, Ghost Turret, Homing Missile, Repulsor, Gamma Beam

Solidus Node: Umbra (February 10-24)

The Solidus Node: Umbra map returns in a dedicated Unranked queue. Navigate its industrial corridors, layered cover, and tight combat zones as close-quarters engagements take center stage once again.

Leagues & Ranked Updates

Season 4 brings smarter League placements and improved matchmaking designed to make ranked play more rewarding for everyone. League Point thresholds have been adjusted to reduce grind and help players climb more smoothly, while still preserving the thrill of earning your rank through consistent performance.

Ranked matchmaking has also been restructured to create fairer, more competitive battles. Bronze and Silver, Gold and Platinum, and Emerald through Noachium players are now matched within tighter skill ranges, ensuring every fight is balanced and exciting. Plus, the maximum queue time for larger crews has been cut in half, so teams spend less time waiting and more time battling.

New Hero Pilot & Mixed War Robot For Credits

Hero Pilot Sora Sing is now available for Credits! 

Unleash this sparky femme fatale as your War Robot’s Pilot. Once stripped of her citizenship and exiled to the Wild Ten for crimes she may not have committed, Sora Sing now brings her explosive skills to the battlefield.

A new Mixed War Robot Build is also available for Credits, featuring:

  • Cyclops Chassis
  • Scorpion Torso
  • Varangian and Phantom Shoulders
  • x4 Locust Weapons
  • Energy Wall Supply Gear
  • Nanite Repair Cycle Gear

Field a versatile, ready-to-fight War Robot without spending premium currency — grab the build for Credits and dominate the battlefield today!

Decker & Crix Join Progression

Two new War Robots — Decker and Crix — are joining the progression system. As you advance through levels, you’ll be able to craft their components and assemble these War Robot Spiders.

Reach the required levels to unlock their components and add Decker and Crix to your hangar.

Enter the Orbital Nexus and Claim Your Place

The stolen blueprints have unleashed a new era of orbital warfare, bringing fresh challenges, powerful technologies, and fierce battles to Tortuga.

The cycle of conflict has begun — sharpen your skills, test your strategies, and make your mark in Season 4 today!
